BugInfo.Description:
`createSocket(InetAddress addr,int port)`方法和`createSocket(InetAddress addr,int port,InetAddress localaddr,int localport)`方法不执行主机名验证，`getInsecure(int handshakeTimeoutMillis,SSLSessionCache cache)`方法返回socket工厂实例，其所有SSL安全检查被禁用。应用程序中调用这些方法易受到to-man-in-the-middle攻击。
**例如**：下列代码中SSLCertificateSocketFactory使用`createSocket(InetAddress addr,int port)`方法获取SSLSocket。 ```java ... SSLCertificateSocketFactory sslCertificateSocketFactory = (SSLCertificateSocketFactory)SSLCertificateSocketFactory.getDefault(0); SSLSocket sslSocket = sslCertificateSocketFactory.createSocket(inetAddress,port); ... ```
BugInfo.Advice: 由于在断开SSL连接上进行的通信可能会泄漏用户信息，因此应用程序不应放弃SSL验证检查。建议采用`createSocket(Socket k,String host,int port,boolean close)`方法，以主机和端口号作为参数建立安全SSL连接。若一定要使用`createSocket()`方法、`createSocket(InetAddress addr,int port)`方法或`createSocket(InetAddress addr,int port,InetAddress localaddr,int localport)`方法，应验证服务器标识，避免受到to-man-in-the-middle攻击。

References.Reference: 297:Improper Validation of Certificate with Host Mismatch
DRD19-J:Properly verify server certificate on SSL/TLS
